propositions: The plan-review gate short-circuits bug tickets to exempt-PASS with zero substantive review (REVIEW_RESULT runner=exempt, llm_calls=0).
FixedBench's 35-65% over-action result has no gate criterion asking whether a proposed change is actually needed (the over-action gap).
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that add mechanisms without establishing need, accepting well-motivated and no-op outcomes.
Bug tickets must receive a lightweight advisory review tier (DET floor + necessity probe only, never blocking) instead of bare exemption.
Both the necessity probe and bug review tier must be registered as ADVISORY in criteria_routing.json and registry without suppressing bug type.
The advisory->blocking promotion for both criteria is dogfood-gated on the standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder (d8a5), recorded as operator-attested observation.
